## Context / Problem

Discovered by the Step-7 sibling sweep while fixing bug facial-lunar-urson (the deployed MCP
image ran Bedrock-configured LLM gates with no Bedrock provider installed).

`infra/compose/Dockerfile.opcert:39` builds with:

```
RUN uv sync --locked --no-dev --extra agents --extra reviewbot
```

There is **no `--extra bedrock`**, yet this image runs the real LLM gates:
`src/rebar/opcert_service/jobs.py:68-76` dispatches `review_plan` and `verify_completion`,
and its docstring states the defaults "call the real LLM". With `rebar.toml:198-199` pinning
`bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8`, that is the same construct as the fixed bug.

## Why it is NOT currently broken (and why it should still change)

The provider import succeeds today **incidentally**: `pyproject.toml:93` defines
`reviewbot = ["fastapi", "uvicorn[standard]", "boto3"]`, and boto3 is the only thing
pydantic-ai-slim's `bedrock` extra actually contributes. So an extra that exists for the
CloudWatch publish path is what keeps the Bedrock provider importable here.

The project has already ruled on exactly this situation in the sibling image.
`infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot` declares `--extra bedrock` and its comment says so
explicitly: "DECLARED FOR EXPLICITNESS, NOT TO FIX A MISSING IMPORT... Naming `bedrock` makes
the dependency INTENTIONAL and lock-enforced. Without it, dropping boto3 from the `reviewbot`
extra — or pydantic-ai-slim later adding a bedrock-extra dependency beyond boto3 — would break
the provider at gate time in production." `Dockerfile.opcert` is the remaining image that has
not had that ruling applied.

## Approach

Add `--extra bedrock` to `Dockerfile.opcert`'s `uv sync` line, with a comment pointing at the
same rationale, and extend the coupling guard added for facial-lunar-urson in
`tests/unit/test_mcp_on_box_infra.py` (or a peer test) so it covers every image that runs LLM
gates, not just `Dockerfile.mcp`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `infra/compose/Dockerfile.opcert` installs the `bedrock` extra and states why.
- [x] A test asserts the provider-extra coupling for EVERY gate-running image
      (`Dockerfile.mcp`, `Dockerfile.reviewbot`, `Dockerfile.opcert`), shown RED for
      `Dockerfile.opcert` before the change.
- [x] `make lint`, `make typecheck` and the infra contract suites pass.
